## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The pull request adds `Cache.set`, raises the default TTL to 300 seconds, and adds round-trip and expiry tests. The new setter breaks case-insensitive storage for mixed-case keys and should be fixed before merge.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — `set` stores keys unchanged while `get` lowercases them: after `c.set("ALPHA", 1)`, both `c.get("ALPHA")` and `c.get("alpha")` return `None`. Normalize keys on insertion to match retrieval. — Values written with mixed-case keys become inaccessible, and those entries bypass expiry cleanup through `get`.
